settings.title: Common Heating Issue: Identifying And Addressing Problems In Pollock Homes

settings.editor:
Even the most well-maintained heating systems can encounter issues over time. Here are some common problems homeowners in Pollock might face:

  1. Furnace Malfunction: If your furnace is blowing cold air, making strange sounds, or not turning on at all, it could indicate a malfunction with components such as the thermostat, igniter, or blower motor.
  2. Heat Pump Troubles: Heat pumps can experience issues like insufficient heating, frequent cycling, or icing up during colder weather. These problems may stem from refrigerant leaks, faulty sensors, or compressor issues.
  3. Boiler Problems: Leaking pipes, strange sounds, or inconsistent heating are signs of potential boiler problems. Issues with the thermostat, circulator pump, or pressure relief valve could be the culprits.
